set -Eeuo pipefail
sudo -n -H /usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, json, re, ast, os
root=Path('/opt/telegram-robot-leads')
sha=(root/'.verified-source-commit').read_text().strip()
print('SHA',sha)
print('OWNER_UID',root.stat().st_uid,'CURRENT_UID',os.geteuid())
for name in ('scripts/safe_runtime.py','scripts/organic_growth.py','scripts/leads_operational_report.py','scripts/operational_report.py','scripts/growth_tracker.py','ecosystem.config.js'):
 p=root/name
 if not p.exists(): print('FILE_MISSING',name);continue
 s=p.read_text()
 print('FILE',name,'LINES',len(s.splitlines()),'KEYWORDS',[(x,len(re.findall(x,s,re.I))) for x in ('supervisor','notify','approval','join_requests','telegram','send_message')])
 if name.endswith('.py'):
  tree=ast.parse(s)
  print('FUNCS',[(n.name,n.lineno,n.end_lineno) for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef))])
print('REGISTRY',[(str(p),p.is_file(),p.stat().st_size if p.exists() else None) for p in (Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads/operation-state.json'),Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads/supervisor-events.jsonl'))])
print('SUPERVISOR_LATEST_EVENTS')
j=Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads/supervisor-events.jsonl')
if j.exists():
 tail=j.open('rb').read()[-16000:].splitlines()[-10:]
 for b in tail:
  try:
   e=json.loads(b)
   print(json.dumps({'kind':e.get('kind'),'organic_growth':e.get('organic_growth'),'created_at':e.get('created_at'),'timestamp':e.get('timestamp')},sort_keys=True)[:900])
  except (ValueError,UnicodeError):pass
print('SUPERVISOR_POLLERS')
for rootdir in ('/opt/telegram-robot-leads','/home/ubuntu','/opt'):
 d=Path(rootdir)
 if rootdir=='/opt':
  for x in d.iterdir():
   if x.is_dir() and any(word in x.name.casefold() for word in ('telegram','supervisor')):
    print('SERVICE_DIR',x.name)
print('PM2_PROCESS_REDACTED')
a=subprocess.run(['pm2','jlist'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15,env={**os.environ,'PM2_HOME':'/root/.pm2'},check=True)
for p in json.loads(a.stdout):
 e=p.get('pm2_env',{})
 print('PROC',p.get('name'),'STATUS',e.get('status'),'SCRIPT',e.get('pm_exec_path'),'RESTARTS',e.get('restart_time'))
print('READONLY_PREFLIGHT_DONE')
PY
